Mobile boat mechanics in Tarpon Springs, FL

Home base. Tarpon Springs boats live on the Anclote River, in the canals off Whitcomb Bayou and Lake Tarpon, and on trailers headed for Anclote River Park and Fred Howard Park. Mechanics in the network reach anywhere in town within the hour.

Waters
  • Anclote River and the Sponge Docks
  • Anclote Key and the Gulf flats
  • Whitcomb Bayou and Spring Bayou canals
  • Lake Tarpon (freshwater, bass boats)
Ramps and marinas
  • Anclote River Park (public ramp, Baillies Bluff Rd)
  • Fred Howard Park causeway
  • Sunset Beach
  • Craig Park on Spring Bayou (small boats)
Boats we see

Flats and bay boats, Gulf center consoles, pontoons on Lake Tarpon, sailboats and trawlers along the river, commercial sponge and shrimp boats.

What breaks in Tarpon Springs

  • Shallow-water prop and skeg damage on the Anclote flats
  • Corrosion on lift-kept boats a quarter mile from the Gulf
  • Ethanol fuel problems on boats that sit through summer

Questions we get

Do you come to the Sponge Docks and the river marinas?

Yes. Mechanics carry insurance certificates for the marinas that require them.

How fast can someone get to Tarpon?

Same day for most calls; emergencies at the ramp are handled by whoever is closest.
